source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 10 May 1930, p. 3 ("L.G. Elections: Fermanagh Nominations"); Fermanagh Times, 5 June 1930, p. 5 ("Lisnaskea Rural District (the polls)")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: sole nomination in the Fermanagh Herald list (10 May 1930, p. 3; the division is missing from the Fermanagh Times list); the only Lisnaskea Rural polls were Ballindarragh, Castlebalfour and Lisnaskea (Fermanagh Times, 5 June 1930, p. 5)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Three contests, Castlebalfour, Lisnaskea and Ballindarragh; the Unionists won all three. The uncontested divisions are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Completed 7 Nov 2026 (meetings-fermanagh1930) from the Fermanagh Times nominations report (8 May 1930, p. 8, read on the page image): 26 divisions returned unopposed; Brookeborough, missing from that list, is taken from the Fermanagh Herald's list (10 May 1930, p. 3). Where the two papers print a name differently, the contest note gives both. Read from the Herald's OCR text; not image-checked. Returned unopposed.
